currentConcept.role: current concept: read contractions and understand the apostrophe as representing omitted letter(s)
currentConcept.notes: Introductory and ongoing concept. Source sequence begins with contractions formed with not, including irregular don't and won't, then expands to contractions with am, are, is, will, would, have, and had.

currentConcept.role: current concept: read singular possessive nouns
currentConcept.notes: Source labels this as Subsequent Lessons after contraction work.

currentConcept.role: current concept: read plural possessive nouns
currentConcept.notes: Source identifies plural possessives as an advanced concept to teach after singular possessives are mastered.

sourceOrderedTeachingSequence.notes: No new letter-sounds. Teach contractions first; singular and plural possessives are subsequent concepts. Part 4 provides separate contraction and possessive wordlist types and explicitly states there are no nonsense words for charting.
No new sounds in Part 6. Spelling contractions is introductory/ongoing; singular and plural possessives are subsequent lessons.

soundInventoryRefs.role: cumulative previously taught sound inventory through 7.4
soundInventoryRefs.notes: The Step Instruction explicitly states that no new letter-sounds/sounds are introduced in 7.5.

wordElementRefs.role: previously taught Word Element Cards remain eligible as needed
wordElementRefs.notes: 7.5 introduces an apostrophe card/tile, not a new prefix, suffix, Latin base, or Greek combining form.

hfwRefs.locator: PDF-p-11 / printed-p-5: body, anybody, everybody, nobody, somebody, won't, usual, usually, probably, either, neither

reviewPoolRefs.role: actual previous-Substep controlled review pool for 3-4 prior words
verified prior-Substep Wilson nonsense-word pool eligible only as cumulative review when Part 8 calls for nonsense words
reviewPoolRefs.notes: Substep 7.5 has no current nonsense-word list and no nonsense-word charting. Never label 7.1N items as 7.5 nonsense words.

selectionRules: Be selective with previously taught vowel, consonant, and welded Letter-Sound Cards.
There are no new letter-sounds in 7.5; do not invent or introduce a new sound card.

contentRefs.role: Introductory and ongoing reading instruction for contractions
Subsequent reading instruction for singular and plural possessive nouns

selectionRules: Begin with 3-4 actual 7.4 review words.
For an Introduction lesson, begin with contractions. Do not pull singular/plural possessives forward from the source's Subsequent Lessons sequence.
Once contractions are established, teach singular possessives before plural possessives.

contentRefs.role: current Word Card direction and contraction activity

selectionRules: Begin with the existing previous-Substep fat stack; do not fabricate it.
Use current 7.5 Word Cards only for concepts already taught at that point in the source sequence.
The WRS Word Cards provide a contraction sample; additional source-consistent contraction cards may be prepared as directed by the Step Instruction.

contentRefs.role: Part 4 list types and charting boundary

selectionRules: Practice with 5-6 words from one current-substep list reflecting the day's instruction.
For charting, use another current-substep list reflecting instruction and select 15 real words.
No nonsense-word charting is provided in 7.5.
Select the exact current sentence page that matches the concepts taught so far and embed all 10 sentences.
When contractions have been taught, have the student identify the contraction and name the two words combined.
When possessives have been taught, have the student identify the possessive noun and explain ownership.
Use previously taught vowel, consonant, and welded phonemes only; there are no new sounds in 7.5.
Previously taught word elements may be dictated as needed.

contentRefs.role: Introductory and ongoing spelling instruction for contractions
Subsequent spelling instruction for singular and plural possessives

selectionRules: Begin with 3-4 actual 7.4 words before current 7.5 spelling work.
For an Introduction lesson, teach spelling contractions before possessive spelling.
Use the source distinction between plural -s/-es and apostrophe placement to show possession; do not collapse plural and possessive rules.

contentRefs.locator: words: PDF-pp-24-25 / printed-pp-18-19; phrases: PDF-p-28 / printed-p-22; sentences: PDF-pp-37-38 / printed-pp-31-32

contentRefs.role: verified cumulative Wilson nonsense-word pool for the required Part 8 nonsense category

selectionRules: Use source-verified Dictation Book items for current 7.5 real words, phrases, and sentences.
There are no new marking directions in 7.5; mark previously taught concepts as appropriate.
If the active Part 8 contract calls for nonsense words, use verified 7.1N items only as cumulative review and label them that way.
Select the next unread controlled passage in Reader sequence using the group's passage history.
If passage history is uncertain, flag it rather than infer it.
Project default: Part 10 remains TBD unless explicitly requested.

notebook.locator: PDF-p-62 / printed-p-58: Spelling Rules/Generalizations — singular vs. plural possessive examples
notebook.role: Spelling notebook entry/reference for possessive nouns
